name: אינטגרציה בחלקים פעמיים – tⁿ·ln²(t) (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Integrate {{CT:0}} with respect to {{CT:1}}.

[[input:ans1]]
[[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
Outline: Integrate by parts twice: first to remove the square of the logarithm, then to remove the logarithm itself.
Step 1 — First integration by parts
If \(u\) and \(v\) are both functions of {{CT:1}} then

\[ \int u dv = uv - \int v du. \]

Let \(u = {{CT:2}}\) and \(dv = {{CT:3}} d{{CT:4}}\). Then \(du = {{CT:5}} d{{CT:4}}\) and \(v = {{CT:6}}\). So,

\[ \begin{aligned} \int {{CT:7}} d{{CT:4}} &= \int u dv \\ &= uv - \int v du \\ &= {{CT:2}}\cdot \left({{CT:6}}\right) - \int {{CT:6}}\cdot \left({{CT:5}}\right)d{{CT:4}} \\ &= {{CT:8}} - \int {{CT:9}}d{{CT:4}} \end{aligned} \]

Step 2 — Second integration by parts
To calculate

\[ \int {{CT:9}}d{{CT:4}} \]

we will have to use parts again, by defining \(u = {{CT:10}}\) and \(dv = {{CT:11}}d{{CT:4}}\) so that \(du = {{CT:12}}d{{CT:4}}\) and \(v = {{CT:13}}\). So,

\[ \begin{aligned} \int {{CT:9}}d{{CT:4}} &= \int u dv \\ &= uv - \int v du \\ &= {{CT:10}}\cdot \left({{CT:13}}\right) - \int {{CT:13}}\cdot \left({{CT:12}}\right)d{{CT:4}} \\ &= {{CT:14}} - \int {{CT:15}}d{{CT:4}} \\ &= {{CT:16}} + c \end{aligned} \]

Step 3 — Combining the results
Hence,

\[ \begin{aligned} \int {{CT:7}} d{{CT:4}} &= {{CT:8}} - \int {{CT:9}}d{{CT:4}} \\ &= {{CT:8}} - \left({{CT:17}}\right) \\ &= {{CT:18}} \end{aligned} \]
